checks.name: Six exact branches, five channel-labelled menus and twenty unconfirmed dishes
Rights, source URLs, date, ingredient, duplicate and cross-branch validation
Ninety-day boundary, changed-source status and withdrawal remain honest
Development gate, same-origin and private reviewer capability
Catalogue GET validates every state and sends no-store
Review writes preserve history and reject stale editors and invalid decisions
Corrupt review state fails closed without silently clearing decisions
Deleting a guest collection retains staff review; canonical facts never mutate

scope: Actual API handlers and atomic store in an isolated development fixture; no publication.
